author: guitargeek
body:
root::RooFitFunction wraps a funct:: expression of PhysicsTools/Utilities as a RooAbsReal. Its only user is its own example program, testRooFitFunction, and GitHub's code search finds none outside copies of CMSSW either.

It has only ever cost maintenance: since the import into git (CMSSW_6_2_0_pre8), every commit that touched it was a repository-wide sweep (static_assert for BOOST_STATIC_ASSERT, clang-format, std:: for boost shared pointers, clang-tidy, the removal of boost dependencies) or an adaptation to ROOT: #39066 had to change it when ROOT deleted the move constructor of RooRealProxy. None added a feature or fixed a problem someone had using it. Remove the header and its test program.

PhysicsTools/Utilities keeps its roofitcore dependency, which SideBandSubtraction needs.
title: Remove RooFitFunction, which nothing uses
